purpose: A deterministic diagnostic miniworld that checks whether the frozen 9-condition mechanism-v2 experiment matrix produces identifiable reach, timing, content, and treatment-control contrasts without using real LLM calls, formal samples, p-values, or production-parameter tuning.

network.directed_rule: for each BA undirected edge, add one directed edge from the higher-degree endpoint to the lower-degree endpoint, matching SocialNetworkPlugin.register_agents

hard_gates: public exposure sets are identical across all 8 treatment conditions for a fixed seed
paid seed budget K is equal across channels
union reach equals public exposure plus paid seed plus paid one-hop exposure
mean hub reach exceeds mean random reach
hub reach exceeds random reach in at least 9 of 12 diagnostic seeds
control retains post-scandal damage at Tick 30
each treatment has positive final-trust gain versus same-seed control
each treatment has positive post-crisis AUC gain versus same-seed control
Immediate early AUC from Tick 6 to Tick 10 exceeds Delayed early AUC for every matched Content x Channel cell
content pathways produce nonzero final-trust contrast for every matched Channel x Timing cell
PBC remains invariant under scandal and clarification signals
same seed and condition reproduce exactly
update_psychological_state source contains no treatment labels
warning_only: If Delayed final Tick 30 trust exceeds Immediate final Tick 30 trust on average, report WARNING final-horizon timing reversal and do not tune memory.
